source_caption:
When Benicio del Toro joined the production of Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another as Sensei Sergio St. Carlos—a local karate instructor who aids Leonardo DiCaprio’s flawed, password-forgetting ex-revolutionary while secretly running an underground immigrant rescue operation he dubs a “Latino Harriet Tubman situation”—he stepped onto a set already in motion with very little time to prepare. In Anderson’s script, del Toro’s character was simply described with the phrase “ocean waves,” a direction the actor used to serve as a deeply grounded, tranquil anchor against DiCaprio’s high-anxiety, erratic energy. This stark contrast in acting dynamics worked so well that it prompted Anderson and the cast to spontaneously alter the script on the spot; upon del Toro’s arrival, the planned narrative setup took a “complete left turn,” allowing their characters to evolve organically as they navigated the film’s chaotic, moving sequences.

One Battle After Another (2025), directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, Benicio del Toro, Chase Infiniti. When his ruthless nemesis resurfaces after sixteen years, a washed-up former revolutionary living off-the-grid must navigate his paranoid past to rescue his missing daughter, blending Thomas Pynchon’s Vineland with an intense, car-chase-fueled action thriller.

source_details.synopsis: One Battle After Another is a 2025 American epic action-comedy thriller film written, directed, and produced by Paul Thomas Anderson. Inspired by the 1990 novel Vineland by Thomas Pynchon, the film's ensemble cast includes Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, Benicio del Toro, Regina Hall, Teyana Taylor, and Chase Infiniti, in her film debut. The film follows a drug using washed-up former revolutionary who is thrust back into the conflict when an amoral tenacious counterterrorist agent resurfaces after sixteen years to bring them to justice to cover his past sins.
